target.description: Staged Claude reassessment of Research 124: Phase 1 reviews the completed empirical/external evidence program and frozen Requirements V0.2 at the exact pre-owner-source snapshot; later Phase 2 may expose the owner source only after Phase-1 evidence is durably frozen.

known_exposures: Claude previously participated in MC-0011 and therefore knows the pre-evidence Research 124 framing and its own Messages 001/003/005 plus the interleaved ChatGPT responses.

Phase 1 intentionally exposes Claude to the completed project-specific audits, failure corpus, ChatGPT-only blind baselines, Research 125-130 external evidence/reconciliation, and owner-frozen Requirements V0.2.
The existence of a separately withheld owner-provided source is known from MC-0011 and the pre-exposure Research 124 history, but its identity/content must remain hidden during Phase 1.

The current coordination branch contains post-exposure material, so Phase 1 limits current-branch access to collaboration-routing files and binds all substantive evidence to the exact pre-exposure review base.
independence.notes: This is not blind to Research 124 or to ChatGPT prior reasoning. Independence is specifically preserved for the incremental effect of the owner-provided source: Claude must first freeze an updated post-evidence/pre-source position before Phase 2 exposure.

last_transition.reason: The project owner explicitly authorized proceeding with a new Claude collaboration after discovering that Claude had not yet evaluated the post-MC-0011 empirical/external evidence program or the later owner source. Phase 1 preserves Claude blindness to the owner source while updating its position on the completed evidence and V0.2 freeze.
